result.keyword: Who are the top medical negligence lawyers in Adelaide?
result.markdown:
Yes. I searched current Adelaide/SA sources, including the latest **Doyle’s Guide** rankings and the Law Society of South Australia. For a patient bringing a medical-negligence claim, the strongest shortlist I’d start with is:

### My top Adelaide shortlist

| Lawyer / firm | Why I’d shortlist them |
|---|---|
| **Michael King — Tindall Gask Bentley (TGB)** | **Top-tier choice.** Doyle’s Guide lists Michael King as **Preeminent** in SA medical-negligence compensation in 2025. He has a long-standing specialist focus on the intersection of medicine and law. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[tgb.com.au](https://tgb.com.au/medical-negligence-lawyers-in-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Peter Jackson — Duncan Basheer Hannon (DBH)** | Also ranked **Preeminent** by Doyle’s Guide for plaintiff medical-negligence work. This is one of the strongest alternatives to TGB. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Gary Allison — TGB** | Ranked **Leading** in the 2025 SA medical-negligence plaintiff category. TGB has a dedicated medical-negligence practice in Adelaide. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[tgb.com.au](https://tgb.com.au/medical-negligence-lawyers-in-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Tim Downie — Johnston Withers** | Ranked **Leading** by Doyle’s Guide and worth considering, particularly if you want a specialist plaintiff firm outside the two largest names above. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Ric Traini — Maurice Blackburn** | Ranked **Leading** in the 2025 SA plaintiff medical-negligence category. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **Fiona Campbell / Matt DeGregorio / Katie Sajatovic — MKF** | Doyle’s Guide places these lawyers in its **Recommended** category. MKF is also a well-reviewed Adelaide personal-injury practice. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |


### If I had to pick just 3

**1. Michael King / TGB** — my first call for a serious or complex medical-negligence claim. TGB has a dedicated SA medical-negligence practice, and King has unusually strong recognition in this particular area. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[tgb.com.au](https://tgb.com.au/medical-negligence-lawyers-in-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Tindall Gask Bentley, Adelaide — 76 Light Square, Adelaide. The firm currently lists its Adelaide office at this address and offers an initial interview. [tgb.com.au](https://tgb.com.au/locations/adelaide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. Peter Jackson / DBH Lawyers** — essentially the other top-tier option based on the specialist ranking. Doyle’s Guide puts Jackson in the **Preeminent** tier alongside King. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. Gary Allison / TGB or Tim Downie / Johnston Withers** — both are strong alternatives in the **Leading** tier. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: Doyle’s Guide says its rankings are based on **peer nominations and interviews and cannot be purchased**, so I would give considerably more weight to these specialist rankings than generic "Top 10 Adelaide lawyers" websites. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[tgb.com.au](https://tgb.com.au/medical-negligence-lawyers-in-south-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-medical-negligence-compensation-law-firms-south-australia-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### What matters when choosing one

Medical-negligence litigation is unusually specialised. The South Australian Law Handbook specifically recommends choosing a solicitor with **actual medical-negligence experience**, noting that cases often require medical records and independent expert opinions before the prospects can be properly assessed. [www.lawhandbook.sa.gov.au](https://www.lawhandbook.sa.gov.au/ch29s06s04.php?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd ask each prospective lawyer:

- How many **medical-negligence cases** do you personally handle?
- Have you handled cases involving **delayed diagnosis, surgical error, medication error, failure to obtain informed consent, birth injury**, etc.?
- Will **you personally** run the case, or will it be passed to another solicitor?
- What medical experts would normally be required?
- Is the initial assessment free?
- What happens if the case needs to go to trial?
- What are the likely legal/medical expert costs if the claim doesn't succeed?

The Law Society of South Australia also operates a lawyer-referral service specifically designed to connect people with firms practising in their required area. [www.lawsocietysa.asn.au](https://www.lawsocietysa.asn.au/site/Shared_Content/Smart-Suite/Smart-Maps/Public/Find-a-Lawyer.aspx?search-open=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Law Society SA — Find a Lawyer](https://www.lawsocietysa.asn.au/site/Shared_Content/Smart-Suite/Smart-Maps/Public/Find-a-Lawyer.aspx?search-open=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If you tell me what happened** (e.g. misdiagnosis, surgery, hospital error, birth injury, cosmetic procedure, medication error, death, etc.) and roughly **when it happened**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Adelaide lawyers most suited to that particular type of claim**, including their recent case experience and fee arrangements.

### What matters when choosing one

Medical-negligence litigation is unusually specialised. The South Australian Law Handbook specifically recommends choosing a solicitor with **actual medical-negligence experience**, noting that cases often require medical records and independent expert opinions before the prospects can be properly assessed. [www.lawhandbook.sa.gov.au](https://www.lawhandbook.sa.gov.au/ch29s06s04.php?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd ask each prospective lawyer:

- How many **medical-negligence cases** do you personally handle?
- Have you handled cases involving **delayed diagnosis, surgical error, medication error, failure to obtain informed consent, birth injury**, etc.?
- Will **you personally** run the case, or will it be passed to another solicitor?
- What medical experts would normally be required?
- Is the initial assessment free?
- What happens if the case needs to go to trial?
- What are the likely legal/medical expert costs if the claim doesn't succeed?

The Law Society of South Australia also operates a lawyer-referral service specifically designed to connect people with firms practising in their required area. [www.lawsocietysa.asn.au](https://www.lawsocietysa.asn.au/site/Shared_Content/Smart-Suite/Smart-Maps/Public/Find-a-Lawyer.aspx?search-open=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Law Society SA — Find a Lawyer](https://www.lawsocietysa.asn.au/site/Shared_Content/Smart-Suite/Smart-Maps/Public/Find-a-Lawyer.aspx?search-open=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If you tell me what happened** (e.g. misdiagnosis, surgery, hospital error, birth injury, cosmetic procedure, medication error, death, etc.) and roughly **when it happened**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Adelaide lawyers most suited to that particular type of claim**, including their recent case experience and fee arrangements.
